text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Just kiddin'! How's that? Caught ya off 
guard, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You Trainers are, in a sense, strategists. 
And strategists, as history shows, are 
frequently targeted.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Be exceedingly cautious, thou hear'st? 
...Especially since thou art quite useful 
to me.
